stem:
Myra tests the same handful of peanuts. The protein test gives a violet colour with copper sulphate and caustic soda. A lasting oily patch appears on paper held to the light.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: These peanuts contain fat, so one food item can contain more than one nutrient.
These peanuts contain fat only, because an oily patch rules out protein.
Every food item must contain both protein and fat.

teacher.key_rationale: Positive protein and fat tests on the same peanuts show more than one nutrient in one food. Treating the oily patch as ruling out protein, or claiming every food has both, miss that hinge.
